description: Sample of the kernel's three hook points in the new format (an object, id = key, input schema required, other keys free); would live at $AOS_HOME/lib/tools/aos/kernel/hooks.json. Written from the README, types not checked line by line against the code.

before_verdict.description: a new request letter is about to be judged by the built-in rules (letters already in the queue do not pass here again)

body.description: the request; its shape is the station's own (see the station's requests file)

after_verdict.description: the station judged a new letter, or a queued letter leaves the queue

verdict.description: pass, refuse or queue from the rules; an earlier hook may have changed it

decision.description: stations that can hold only: pass when someone already said so, else null

next.description: stations that forward only: null (the hook may give the next mailbox)

before_reply.description: a reply passes this station on its way back
